name: ip-license-election-and-attestation
title: IP License Election and Attestation
description: License selection (CC / CBE / PIL / embedded) > rights matrix comparison > compatibility check > terms assembly > rights record > certified license VC with execution hash binding. The election step is interchangeable across license families; the compatibility check applies when a parent asset constrains the child license.

steps.handoff: Selected license_id, spdx_id, and required_elements feed Stage 2 cross-license rights comparison
Canonical rights vectors and diff feed Stage 3 compatibility check
Compatibility verdict and reason codes feed Stage 4 terms assembly
Rendered license terms feed Stage 5 rights record builder
Normalized rights record and record_hash feed Stage 6 license election certification
Exports certified license election VC with execution_hash binding -- final stage
